Awning fix: the top of the reception window at panel upper-left now carries a plain, flat teal band above a white frame strip, with foliage behind. I see no blue-and-white stripes, scallops or leftover striped colour. The teal matches the hue of the entrance awning in 01-1 and the teal dado on the reception wall. The contradiction raised in r7 is resolved.

Edit quality: the teal band has clean straight edges that meet the white window frame and the wall without halos, smears, doubled lines or texture changes. The trees, potted plants and wall next to it look undisturbed. I found no new defect at the viewing size.

Identity against main-cast.png: Meera has a round face, large round eyes with visible lower lashes, thin high-arched brows, a side braid over her left shoulder (image right) with a teal tie, and the blue kurta with white leaf motifs and an embroidered neckline. The silver bangle is on her right wrist. All match.

Hands and props: she faces the viewer. Her left hand (image right) holds the beige receiver to her left ear, and the coiled cord runs to the beige desk phone at right. Her right hand (image left) holds a pen over the open register. The tall register stack is at left. This matches production.hands.meera and the desk-phone/meera.left, pen/meera.right and registers/none records.

Acting: raised brows, a sweat drop, an open mouth and ringing lines read as flustered but friendly, matching the beat and source Page 1 Panel 2 (paper registers, ringing phone, queue). Three queue patients are seen from behind in the foreground.
No readable text: the register pages show only blank ruled lines, the phone keypad has no digits, and the book spines carry no lettering.

Continuity: the grey perforated chairs match 01-1. In page-01.png both balloons sit in the empty upper white area in left-to-right order. Their tails end at the top of her head and do not cover her face, the phone or the teal band.
